description:
Lists DNS records for a domain

HTTP: GET /v1/dns/zones/:domain_id/records
Category: DNS
Required scopes: dns:read
Returns: {status, data: array of {id, zone_id, type, name, content, ttl, priority, weight, port, auth, external_record_id, disabled, … (+4 more)}, meta}
Read-only.

_fields.description: Comma-separated item fields to keep, e.g. "id,domain_name,php_version" — trims large items to what you need.

_limit.description: Keep only the first N items of the returned list (applied by this MCP server, not the panel). Use on large lists.

_match.description: Keep only items whose JSON contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a domain name or status.

domain_id.description: UUID of the domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

name: panelica_dns_get_v1_dns_zones_domain_id_records
